stops.title: Nhyehyɛeɛ
stops.caption: Asɛmpaka, a ɛda ne beaeɛ wɔ ho.
stops.speech: Asɛmpaka nhyehyɛeɛ ne asɛmpaka adwuma no: baabi, berɛ bɛn, ne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔrekɔ.

stops.title: Kyerɛw ɔkra
stops.caption: Din ne nɔma dɔɔso.
stops.speech: Wɔ asɛmpaka mu, wokyerɛw nnipa a wohyia wɔn. Din ne telefon nɔma dɔɔso sɛ wode bɛfiri aseɛ; kwan no gye firi hɔ.
